items.summary: Recommendation: reject all new implementation, spend, and monetization admissions this cycle. Preserve only the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case; after one delivery slot is released and site overlap clears, retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the lowest-risk, fastest-to-learn test. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, or causal lift.

Financial attribution is insufficient for site-level revenue claims. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 is entirely in aggregate tracking row `other`; named site rows show $0 commission. Therefore site contribution margin, revenue per site, ROI, and revenue lift are not calculable. Minimum measurement: retain registered tracking IDs for every affiliate link and reconcile site/content identifiers to clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, and reporting period.

Contribution margin and budget exposure are not calculable from the brief. AI spend is $2.2785467 on 2026-10-01 across 16 calls and only 4 instrumented sites; infrastructure, hosting, registrar, labor, and direct change costs are absent. Monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Do not infer budget headroom or fleet profitability. Minimum measurement: a dated report-only cost ledger joining site-level AI usage, hosting/infrastructure charges, domain costs, and directly attributable implementation costs to attributable commission revenue.

Cost-to-learn is not calculable for the proposed allthingsmasonic.com test because incremental implementation cost, page-level baseline, and causal control data are unavailable. Retain the existing 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 commission. If executed after capacity clearance, measure affiliate clicks for 14 days after verified deployment, report orders and commission only if available, and treat the result as descriptive rather than causal unless a valid control exists.

Push back on vanity metrics: impressions, clicks, sessions, AI calls, output tokens, proposal counts, and shipped work do not establish economic value. The actionability snapshot records 5000 audited actions, 356 proposals, 288 approved proposals, and only 6 proven outcomes; these are operating-volume measures, not financial performance. Preserve the existing capacity gate and require attributable economic outcomes before expanding work.

Keep SearchWoot private and do not approve affiliate or advertising expansion. Its measurement and attribution gate is blocked, and the available fleet evidence does not support a monetization forecast. No finance proposal is retained because the current decision is containment, not additional reporting capacity.
